Questions

What clients often ask.

The number depends on the garment and complexity. We confirm the likely fitting plan during consultation and adjust if the garment requires it.
As a planning guide, shirts may take 1–2 weeks and complex suits 2–3 weeks. Fabric availability, design, fittings, workload and delivery location can change this.
Yes, subject to inspection. We will check width, length, condition and suitability before accepting it for a garment.
It depends on measurements, fabric width, pattern matching and design. Use our calculator for a preliminary range, then confirm with us before purchasing.
Included adjustments depend on the agreed order. We explain the fitting and alteration scope before work begins.
Wedding coordination can include suits, shirts, waistcoats and accessories. The final package is tailored to the group, timing and fabric.
Express work may be possible depending on fabric, complexity and capacity. An express charge may apply.
You can submit an enquiry profile online, but professional confirmation is recommended before cutting.
Care depends on fabric and construction. We provide garment-specific guidance at collection.
Contact us promptly. We will assess fit against the agreed measurements and explain the available adjustment options.
